描述_EN: the border has a pattern of three baskets of flowers. the design on the hanging is composed of two birds on conventional rocks from which grow peonies and magnolias. table hanging and border of red silk satin, embroidered with coloured silks. round the piece runs a narrow band of inter-scrolls, swastikas and rosettes.
描述_ZN: 边框上有一个三个花篮的图案。 挂件上的图案是由传统岩石上的两只鸟组成的，岩石上长着牡丹和玉兰花。 桌挂和红绸缎的边框，绣有彩色的丝绸。 作品周围有一条狭长的卷轴、卐字和玫瑰花带。
